title: Another Series on Floods, Etc.
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 46.175–184 Linked Discourses 46.175–184
  • 18. Punaoghavagga 18. Another Chapter on Floods

Punaoghādisutta Another Series on Floods, Etc.

…pe… (Tell in full as in SN 45.171–180.)

Bojjhaṅgasaṁyuttassa punaoghavaggo aṭṭhārasamo.

Uddānaṁ

Ogho yogo upādānaṁ, Ganthā anusayena ca; Kāmaguṇā nīvaraṇā, Khandhā oruddhambhāgiyānīti.

(Rāgavinayapariyosāna-dosavinayapariyosāna-mohavinayapariyosānavaggo vitthāretabbo.) (Tell in full as in the chapter on removal of greed, hate, and delusion.)

(Yadapi maggasaṁyuttaṁ vitthāretabbaṁ, tadapi bojjhaṅgasaṁyuttaṁ vitthāretabbaṁ.) (The Linked Discourses on Awakening Factors should be told in full just as the Linked Discourses on the Path.)

Bojjhaṅgasaṁyuttaṁ dutiyaṁ. The Linked Discourses on the Awakening Factors, the second section.
